title: God Sends the Holy Spirit
lines: These are the apostles. They followed Jesus during his time on earth.
這些是使徒，耶穌在世的時候，他們一直跟隨祂。
Before Jesus went to heaven, he told them to stay in Jerusalem until God sent the gift he promised.
耶穌升天以前，吩咐他們留在耶路撒冷，等候神所應許的恩賜。
So after Jesus went to heaven, the apostles stayed in Jerusalem along with the other people who believed in Jesus.
所以耶穌升天以後，使徒們和其他信耶穌的人一起留在耶路撒冷。
One day they were all gathered together when there was a sound from heaven like a mighty windstorm.
有一天，他們都聚集在一起，忽然從天上有響聲，好像一陣大風。
Then what looked like flames appeared and settled on each of them, and everyone was filled with the Holy Spirit.
接著有像火焰的舌頭顯現，分開落在他們各人頭上，他們就都被聖靈充滿。
The Holy Spirit gave them the ability to speak in other languages, and so they started speaking.
聖靈賜給他們說別國語言的能力，他們就開始說起來。
At that time, there were devout Jews from every nation living in Jerusalem.
那時，有從各國來的虔誠猶太人住在耶路撒冷。
When they heard the loud noise, they came running to see what it was.
他們聽見這巨大的聲響，就跑來看是怎麼回事。
When they saw the believers speaking in their own languages, they were shocked and amazed.
他們聽見信徒說著自己家鄉的語言，都驚訝萬分。
They wondered, "How can this be? These people are from Galilee, and yet we hear them speaking in our own native languages about the wonderful things God has done!"
他們心想：「這是怎麼回事？這些人都是加利利人，我們怎麼聽見他們用我們的鄉談，講說神的大作為呢？」
But others in the crowd didn't believe that it was really a miracle, and thought the believers were just acting oddly.
但人群中也有人不相信這是神蹟，以為信徒們只是舉止怪異。
Then Peter stepped forward and shouted to the crowd, "Listen carefully, all of you!"
彼得就站出來，向眾人高聲說：「你們都要留心聽！」
He told them that they were not acting strangely, but that this was from God.
他告訴他們，這些人不是行為怪異，這是從神來的。
He reminded them that God said this would happen long ago.
他提醒他們，神很久以前就說過這事要發生。
Then Peter told them about how Jesus was crucified, but then raised to life again, just as God had said he would be.
接著彼得告訴他們，耶穌怎樣被釘十字架，又照神所說的復活了。
He told them that Jesus was now in heaven, and that God had given the Holy Spirit to them as he had promised.
他告訴他們，耶穌現在在天上，神也照祂所應許的，把聖靈賜給了他們。
Peter's words changed what the people thought and felt, and they asked, "Brothers, what should we do?"
彼得的話改變了眾人的想法和感受，他們就問：「弟兄們，我們當怎樣行？」
Peter told them, "Each of you must repent of your sins and turn to God, and be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins."
彼得說：「你們各人要悔改，歸向神，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦。」
"Then you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit."
Peter continued to preach to the crowd for a long time, and those who believed what Peter said were baptized.
彼得繼續向群眾講了很久，凡相信他話的人都受了洗。
Three thousand people were baptized and added to the church that day.
那天受洗加入教會的約有三千人。
Then all the believers listened to the apostles' teaching and practiced what they taught.
所有信徒都聽從使徒的教導，並且實踐出來。
They met together in fellowship, shared meals, and prayed together.
他們彼此交接、一起用餐、一同禱告。
They were amazed as the apostles performed many miraculous signs and wonders.
使徒們行了許多神蹟奇事，眾人都很驚奇。
All the believers met together in one place and shared everything they had.
信的人都聚在一處，凡物公用。
They helped those in need, worshiped together at the temple every day, met in homes for the Lord's Supper, and shared their meals with great joy.
他們幫助有需要的人，天天同心在聖殿敬拜，在家中擘餅記念主，歡歡喜喜地一同吃飯。
All while praising God and enjoying each other.
他們讚美神，也彼此享受相處的時光。
And each day God added to their fellowship those who were being saved.
主將得救的人天天加給他們。
